notes: This package adds cross-pack-deduplicated international-student candidates across north-China, specialist and sparse formal-catalog institutions, plus two previously absent regional normal universities.
Every candidate has trilingual display names and trilingual official-evidence summaries; all source URLs are official HTTPS pages or official university-hosted PDFs.
Only Shenyang Normal University's December 2026 four-week program and the explicitly dated DUT/Shenyang Normal scholarship windows remain open as of 2026-08-04.
All passed 2026 deadlines are explicitly closed and must not be surfaced as currently open.
China Conservatory of Music, Hebei Normal University and Shanxi Medical University were not padded with domestic or third-party records.
All scholarship-to-program references resolve to candidate IDs inside this package, and same-school same-level semantic duplicates were excluded against the formal catalog.
